title: Verb forms: gerunds and participles printed in the sources

fields.name: lemma
fields.description: The base verb (infinitive), as the source pairs it with the form; for forms the AB 2018 word list prints on their own, the headword they belong to (see _meta/conventions.md)

fields.name: word_id
fields.description: Id of the lemma's row in lexicon/words/ (the verb row when the headword has several)

fields.name: form
fields.description: The gerund or participle exactly as the source prints it

fields.name: form_word_id
fields.description: Id of the form's own row in lexicon/words/, when the AB 2018 word list prints it as a headword

fields.name: irregular
fields.description: yes: Morfologia (§6.6.2.2, §6.6.3.2) or a maintainer ruling lists it as irregular. no: it follows the formation rules of §6.6.2.1 or §6.6.3.1. Empty: neither (for example a verb ending in a consonant).

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.description: GitHub usernames of the reviewers, separated by '; '. Required when status is reviewed.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Printed page number(s): the word-list page for AB2018, the book page for MOR2010.

fields.name: section
fields.description: The source's section number, e.g. 6.6.2.2. Empty for the AB 2018 word list.

$comment: Frictionless Table Schema plus x-papiamento extensions read by tools/validate.py. See _meta/conventions.md.
